name: Verifying
description: Responsible for validating and assessing the novelty of generated peptide sequences by performing homology searches against established biological databases and retrieving relevant annotations.

tools.description: Conducts a remote BLAST sequence alignment (via NCBI's BLAST server) against the SwissProt database. It retrieves the most homologous sequences, extracts their taxonomic classifications, and pulls cross-referenced database annotations.

context: This verification module evaluates the output produced by the generation module, translating natural language validation requests from the planning phase into structured database queries.
This deployment currently only checks generated sequences against SwissProt. DBAASP-based verification is temporarily disabled pending an API key -- do not request or expect a DBAASP cross-reference.
This verification step should be executed as the final stage in the pipeline.
